correctness.rationale: Exact factorization U_{q,pb+a}=U_{q-1,b}(1+p^q z_{b,a}), exact cancellation at exponent one, odd-prime lifting of units, and binomial bound for all j>=2 give F_q(t) = p F_(q-1)(t) mod p^(q+m+1). Base harmonic-sum calculation yields leading unit -(t-1)/p^m, therefore exact valuation. An independent finite verifier checks 286 cases.
